# Viabtech (Viab Tech Ltd)

> Viabtech is Tanzania's authorized reseller and authorized service center for Canon and Epson, based in Dar es Salaam. Founded in 2015, it sells and services printers, plotters, projectors, cameras, lenses, scanners, ink, toner and accessories for businesses, government agencies, institutions and home offices, with delivery across Tanzania.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Viab Tech Limited
- Founded: 2015
- Authorizations: Authorized reseller and authorized service center for Canon and Epson products in Tanzania. Partner programmes include Canon CPP Silver Partner, Epson LFP Registered Partner, Epson Authorized Service Center, HP Business Partner, Dell Authorized Partner and Lenovo 360.
- Brands sold (11): Canon, Epson, HP, Lenovo, Dell, DJI, Godox, Unomat, APC, SanDisk, Lexar
- Customers: 2,000+ clients, including businesses, banks, hospitals and government institutions
- Service area: Dar es Salaam showrooms; delivery nationwide across Tanzania; bulk orders across East Africa
- Payment methods: bank transfer, M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, cheque, cash

## Locations and contact

- Canon Authorized Showroom: Plot No 1357/208, Ground Floor, next to Peacock Hotel, Bibi Titi Mohamed Road, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
- Epson Experience Zone: Ground Floor, Uhuru Heights, Bibi Titi Mohamed Road, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania (P.O. Box 105047)

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.viabtech.com/services): Printer sales and consulting, managed print services and leasing, annual maintenance contracts (AMC), consumables and supplies, spare parts, IT and network setup
- [Service center and repairs](https://www.viabtech.com/service-center): Authorized Canon and Epson repair and maintenance in Dar es Salaam, with an online repair request form
- [Canon warranty registration](https://www.viabtech.com/canon-register): Register a Canon product for warranty

## Frequently asked questions

- Which brands does Viabtech sell? Canon, Epson, HP, Lenovo, Dell, DJI, Godox, Unomat, APC, SanDisk and Lexar. Viabtech is an authorized reseller and service center for Canon and Epson.
- How long do repairs take? Standard repairs take 1 to 3 business days; complex repairs take 5 to 7 business days.
- What warranty do products have? Printers typically carry a 1-year warranty, cameras 2 years, and projectors 2 to 3 years, depending on the model.
- Do you deliver outside Dar es Salaam? Yes, Viabtech delivers nationwide across Tanzania, and handles bulk orders across East Africa.
- How can I pay? Bank transfer, M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, cheque or cash.
- Do you offer printer leasing or maintenance contracts? Yes: managed print services, leasing and annual maintenance contracts (AMC) for businesses and institutions.
